reviews.shade: SOME BY MI PDRN Spirulina Soothing Sherbet Mask 10ea
reviews.text:
I’m pleased to be the first one to review this product. 
It was incredibly light when it arrived. I guess because it’s in the form of powder. I was worried the small sachet of powder would not be enough but I was wrong. 
I love the consistency after putting in water. It gives a very satisfying mixture. And it’s fun to mix it. 
It’s very cooling and soothing after applying onto my face. It’s zero irritation just as it’s advertised. Sometimes I hated it when other products contain too much actives, my compromised skin barriers just wouldn’t like it. Cooling and soothing, is all I wanted. 
I’ll come back and buy it again.
reviews.zh: 好榮幸可以成為第一位評論呢件產品嘅人。收到嘅時候覺得好輕，估計係因為係粉狀。本來擔心嗰一小包粉會唔夠用，但係我錯咗。加水之後嘅質地好正，溝出嚟嘅混合物好有滿足感，而且溝嘅過程好有趣。搽上面之後非常清涼同舒緩，完全同佢廣告講嘅一樣，零刺激。有時其他產品有太多活性成分，我屏障受損嘅皮膚根本接受唔到。清涼同舒緩，就係我想要嘅。我會再回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
